div.div:
Solid arrows: event / control flow
Dashed arrows: read-only investigation access or fault injection
① ② ③: incident escalation order
Protocol: BOTH agent-to-agent links are registered over MCP (mcpserversigv4) —
space-to-space uses SigV4 service ‘aidevops’ + an X-Agent-Space-Id routing header,
the fallback agents use SigV4 service ‘bedrock-agentcore’ and a single ‘investigate’ tool.
The agents can also serve A2A (:9000) and A2A registration scripts are retained,
but A2A has not been exercised on this deployment.
